previousContract.meaning: Preserves destiny, auction, event, mark, sacrifice and human shrine-pick fixtures; this version adds automatic battle and terminal settlement transitions.

source.meaning: Frozen product source for adapter fixtures only; not a balance or release verdict.

scope.game: original solo four-seat game with one human seat and three AI seats
scope.automaticBattle: Call the pinned resolveBattles engine for deterministic combat and supplied chance draws, then preserve its death sweep, night-end hooks, tithe, dawn recovery and history write.
scope.terminalSettlement: Call the pinned shrine-dawn settlement, endgame item strip and final history snapshot; expose stable alive/life ranking without assigning a numeric game-theoretic utility.
scope.chanceBoundary: Targeted fixture for both sides of the current 0.15 lightning threshold. This is not full-game chance enumeration.
deferred: Cross-phase full recall across event, mark, auction, sacrifice and shrine selection
Complete chance support and branch probabilities across the full game
Cross-night snapshot restore and state canonicalization
Terminal utility mapping, policy enumeration and solver review
Measurement of event-night human/AI mark timing asymmetry

fixtures.proves: The frozen automatic battle path distinguishes supplied uniform draws immediately below and exactly at the current 0.15 lightning threshold, and reports the resulting battle and night state.
fixtures.doesNotProve: All paper-war chance events, full chance-tree probabilities, or complete-game chance support.

fixtures.proves: The frozen battle/night-end path resolves curse drain death, unaffordable shrine tithe release, dawn recovery and the sealed night history snapshot in engine order.
fixtures.doesNotProve: Every cross-hook combination, every human tithe prompt branch, or all terminal stop conditions.

fixtures.proves: Terminal settlement calls the engine's shrine dawn settlement, endgame item strip and final history snapshot, then reports UI-consistent alive/life ranking.
fixtures.doesNotProve: A numeric solver payoff, all terminal paths, or cross-night restore equivalence.

nextEngineeringDeliverable.name: cross-phase full recall, chance coverage and cross-night restoration
requirements: Carry each seat's observations and own action through event, mark, auction, sacrifice and shrine-pick phases; reject mixed-seat or hidden-state contamination.
Enumerate or otherwise prove all reachable random branches and their probabilities for a finite full-game state.
Restore cross-night snapshots with canonical engine state and matching gameplay/UI RNG streams.
Measure the event-night human-after-reveal versus AI-before-reveal mark difference on paired seeds before suggesting a product change.
Specify terminal payoff and a feasible policy/solver scope before any full-model pass claim.

gate.blockingReason: Battle, night settlement and terminal fixtures cover selected paths only. Full recall, chance support, cross-night restoration, canonicalization, terminal utility, policy enumeration and independent solver review remain incomplete.
